project.name: sbl-concierge-experience
project.objective: Make the SBL concierge give a visitor a measurably good experience: fast, correct, shown not told, consistent, remembered, never silent, visitor in control; and make the harness able to measure and improve itself against that scorecard without regressions.

assumptions.text: A first visible reaction within 1.5 s is reachable with a small routing prompt on the current model. Unverified; spike S1 measures it.
Typed-mode behaviour predicts voice-mode behaviour closely enough that fixing typed first is the right order. Unverified until the voice suite (T70).
Scripted personas are a usable proxy for real visitors. No real visitor has used the concierge; founder sessions and pilot traces are the check.
A model judge can score the judged rows in agreement with founder labels (>=85%). Unverified until T04.

invariants.text: Safety rules from SPEC v1 stay in force: consequential actions only through the visible confirmation card; passwords only through the private field; live writes only in the CX-TEST workspace; proofs stop before real payment or signup submission.
No change is called an improvement unless the held-out persona suite shows no scorecard row worse beyond the measured noise floor. Self-reported success and a single scripted pass are not evidence.

decisions.text: Candidate = core/site-map.js regenerated 2026-10-13 (220 pages, every URL fetched, offsite links and handoff recorded) plus one router rule (a statement about themselves is acknowledged, no navigation, no plan). Held-out personas, 3 runs each: no row worse than the previous build beyond noise; unrequested navigations 0.33 -> 0. Kept. Rollback: restore var/sitemap/site-map.prev.js or revert the commit. Two changes were evaluated together, so their separate effects are not known.

decisions.title: Preserve held-out honesty expectations; report punctuation false positives
decisions.text: Mining tc1-tc18 found217 literal honest regex misses. Example3707cfbc-cfd1-1 says I don’t see a dentistry-specific case study; the held-out pattern (no |not |n\x27t|cannot|unable|none) does not match curly-apostrophe don’t. This is a measurement false-positive example, not evidence of dishonesty. No persona or scorer edited. Miner labels the cluster honest-regex-miss and preserves exact scoring semantics; founder can decide any future expectation correction.

decisions.title: Reject tc19 global progress guard; test dashboard-only tc20
decisions.text: tc19 held-out E2.busy.p50 regressed from tc9 1988.33 ms to 2569.67 ms, delta +581.33 ms, WORSE under the unchanged comparator. Its global suppression of say before the first do action is rejected. tc20 scopes progress suppression to dashboard and every action gap, and adds dashboard-only guidance to answer conversational capability questions once. tc20 holdout: 87 steps, E1.p50 1480 ms, zero worse rows vs tc9; remaining sets and judge still running. Neither candidate proves a complete dashboard suite or actual signup.

knowledge.title: Experience baseline 2026-10-13
knowledge.text: 37 typed visitor turns by three Sonnet personas on live sbl.so against build/step3-one-brain 0131f74 plus uncommitted step3-wt edits. First line usually 4-6 s (12-15 s on pricing asks); turns 20-105 s with up to 23 model calls; one invented URL (404) then off-site exit to gtm.sbl.so with no dock; three turns with no reply; signup started without request twice; same plan question answered Pro then Starter; in-session fact reuse worked; reload lost the plan recommendation. Typed only, one run per persona, website only; navigation persona busy times are lower bounds (driver 150 s ceiling).

knowledge.title: Causes found in code and logs 2026-10-13
knowledge.text: Charter in core/constitution.js says keep working until goal achieved and never hand work back, goal = trial started. Every reply runs the browser-agent loop: one action per ~20k-token call, 3-5 s each. A refused say shows nothing while the model retries (founder session 2026-10-12 19:12-19:14, 20+ refused says). core/site-map.js generated 2026-09-30: 190 pages, 5 product pages, missing /mcp/ /api/ /faq/. remember is an optional tool; founder customer file had facts {}. Side-speech became a task goal. server.mjs usage line references removed t0, so per-step latency logging is dead in step3-wt. Server cost cap is global 60 calls/min.

knowledge.title: Existing RSI branch learns click outcomes, not experience
knowledge.text: Branch feat/rsi-browser-learning (4 commits on 0131f74) counts per hashed state/action whether an action changed the page and re-ranks proposed actions after 3 matching observations. Its notes state these are action effects, not task success. None of E1-E9 is measured by it. Plan task T64 evaluates it in shadow mode against the scorecard: keep if it moves a row beyond noise, otherwise delete.

knowledge.title: Spike S1: a 1.5 s first line is reachable with a small streamed router call
knowledge.text: Measured 2026-10-13, 35 samples per configuration, streamed /v1/responses. Router prompt with product knowledge (5.2k tokens), gpt-5.6-luna, effort none: first sentence p50 1231 ms / p95 1687 ms, 0 invented targets in 36, target correct 30/36. Without knowledge (2.3k tokens) lines are generic. Full 19k-token prompt answering in one line: 2360 / 3882 ms. Smaller models (gpt-5.4-nano/mini, gpt-4.1-nano) have p95 3.5-4.1 s and invent paths: not better. Forcing a tool call does not delay the first line. Cold prompt cache costs about 2.5 s on the first call; cache lifetime not measured. Engine cannot stream (spike S5), so the router is a separate call before the engine.

knowledge.title: Spike S5: turn contract is implementable without editing the vendored engine
knowledge.text: agent.stop() aborts the in-flight model call immediately; a tool already running completes; halt + agent.stop() from inside a tool ends a run cleanly; onBeforeStep can narrow agent.tools per step; getPageInstructions injects per-step text. Nine silent-turn paths identified in harness.js including a private field with no timeout, done text dropped when the task said anything earlier, messages arriving during wind-down, and failed model calls ending without a line.

knowledge.title: A human handoff exists on the site: the 'Talk to an SDR expert' calendar link
knowledge.text: sbl.so has a 'Talk to an SDR expert' link to a Google Calendar appointment page. In testing the agent clicked it in the visitor's tab, which left the site and the dock (stranded). FR-14 handoff should point at that link and let the visitor open it, not navigate away. Supersedes the planning assumption that no handoff exists.

knowledge.title: Approved welcome: live browser proof and interaction limits
knowledge.text: Founder approved T73 welcome plan explicitly. Current candidate shows one website welcome, waits while typing, stays quiet after an unanswered reload, and does not repeat in another tab; automated browser assertions pass. Native Chrome with the installed loader showed the welcome and accepted a refusal via Send; turn fa3a3387-5eo6-1 stayed on the homepage. Native collapse/reopen and reload passed. Enter-to-send did not submit; direct Playwright click activation also failed while native accessibility activation worked. No input fix is claimed.
